subject.description: AT URI of the record being liked: a site.mochott.article, or a work.sequential.chapter or work.sequential.strip.

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the like was created.

main.description: Record indicating that the account author liked an article or comic. Deleting this record removes the like.

description: A like record. Represents a user's endorsement of an article or a comic chapter or strip.
